notes.title: And we are on Steam... Obviously!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33507561/297c14bd9170094d1128264aeb248f8fa8eded1d.png[/img]Dear landlubbers,

If you are reading this, then we are more than probably really happy right now. 

Welcome on the official Steam page of Shipbreakers, the best place online to get the latest news about the project and its progress. 

Add the game to your wish list to stay updated.

See you, matey.
